sentence.en: The Pace: 6.6% of papers in leading journals named AI methods in the 13 weeks to 16 Aug. That is up from 1.1% in 2015 to 2019, and up from 4.8% a year earlier. Clearly above the pre-AI level in 5 of 7 fields. Too few cases to judge in 1.
sentence.zh: 進度：截至 8 月 16 日的 13 週內，主要期刊有 6.6% 的論文提到 AI 方法，高於 2015 至 2019 年的 1.1%，也高於一年前的 4.8%。7 個領域中有 5 個明顯高於 AI 出現之前。有 1 個領域的案例太少，無法判斷。

text.en: Scholars read the writing inside a sealed ancient scroll without opening it.
text.zh: 學者不必打開，就讀出了一卷密封的古代卷軸裡的文字。

text.en: A lab measured a protein that an AI model had predicted, and the shape matched.
text.zh: 一間實驗室測量了 AI 模型先前預測的蛋白質，形狀相符。

text.en: A publisher pulled many papers with undisclosed AI text, and a research council made its AI rule final.
text.zh: 一家出版商撤下許多含有未揭露 AI 文字的論文，一個研究委員會也讓它的 AI 規定定案。

update.en: The council published its final rule. From 1 January, applicants must say if AI tools helped write any part of a proposal. The final rule covers every part of a proposal, not only the summary.
update.zh: 委員會公布了最終規定。從 1 月 1 日起，申請人必須說明 AI 工具是否協助撰寫了申請書的任何部分。最終規定涵蓋申請書的每個部分，不只是摘要。

text.en: Oren Nominal (SAMPLE) argues that journals should let AI check every submitted proof before human review begins.
text.zh: Oren Nominal（SAMPLE）主張，期刊應該在人工審查開始前，讓 AI 檢查每一份投稿的證明。

text.en: Sana Provisional (SAMPLE) argues that reviewers should be told plainly what they may share with AI tools.
text.zh: Sana Provisional（SAMPLE）主張，應該明確告訴審稿人，他們可以和 AI 工具分享什麼。

title.en: SAMPLE: A model predicts monsoon rainfall weeks ahead
title.zh: SAMPLE：模型提前數週預測季風降雨

title.en: SAMPLE: A public dataset of ancient inscriptions read with machine help
title.zh: SAMPLE：機器協助解讀古代銘文的公開資料集

reason.en: The paper proves the result for the flat plane only. The first text did not say so, and a reader reported it.
reason.zh: 這篇論文只針對平面證明了這項結果。最初的文字沒有這樣說，一位讀者回報了這件事。

reason.en: The weather service's statement says the model runs alongside its own system and has not replaced it. The first text said the service relies on the model.
reason.zh: 氣象機構的聲明表示，這個模型與它自己的系統並行運作，並沒有取代原有的系統。最初的文字說，這個機構依靠這個模型。
